workflow_scale_routing.rationale: A compact 30 second storyboard can stage invitation, threshold, and residue without long-form continuity support.
reroute_triggers: artist expands this into a short film or feature film
recurring characters or world rules become durable continuity
dependent scene batches require checkpointed expansion

character_reference_strategy.notes: The implied apartment host is promoted as a main continuity subject. The package plans three character reference images: identity plate, turnaround sheet, and macro detail card.

visual_reference_sheet_strategy.notes: The hallway is promoted because blocking and light geometry must stay stable across shots. The old television is promoted as a story-critical object; it gets one multi-section object sheet.

video_format.audience: Artist review before any storyboard still generation.
video_format.rationale: The requested compact video can hold the emotional movement as a vertical storyboard without claiming a finished generated video.

symbology_direction.primary_symbolic_representation: A half-open apartment door spilling warm light into a dark hallway.
symbology_direction.rationale: The missing person and lit threshold carry the invitation and unease without literal explanation.
avoid: turning the hallway into a horror reveal

style_direction.rationale: The style keeps the ordinary hallway believable so the threshold carries the pressure.

video_style_expression.color_light_style: warm practical light against cool hallway shadow
video_style_expression.style_direction_notes: Every shot should feel possible as a real camera observation, even when storyboarded as still prompts.

visual_dynamics.target_visual_engine: A narrow hallway compresses the viewer toward a warm doorway that withholds its cause.

active_visual_tensions.active_pole_summary: The open door implies a presence that never appears.
active_visual_tensions.translation_notes: Hold empty space long enough for absence to feel active.

active_visual_tensions.active_pole_summary: Warm light promises safety while the dark hallway keeps threat unresolved.
active_visual_tensions.translation_notes: Avoid jump-scare motion; keep the tension in the uncertain invitation.

minimum_tension_criteria.criteria: Each adjacent Storyboard Shot must change the viewer's distance, information, or pressure around the lit threshold.
minimum_tension_criteria.required_adjacent_difference: Adjacent shots must differ on at least one Shot Design axis and one emotional or visual tension axis unless the repetition is explicitly serving dread.

video_scenes.scene_purpose: Move from ordinary approach to unresolved invitation.
video_scenes.setting: A narrow apartment hallway at night.
video_scenes.local_tension: The viewer is pulled toward light while the cause stays absent.

visual_unit.composition_intent: Establish distance and make the lit doorway small but unavoidable.
visual_unit.communication_intent: The invitation exists before the viewer understands it.
visual_unit.expectation_turn_translation: The warm light promises welcome, but the empty hall denies a host.
visual_unit.active_tension_profile: Low motion, high absence, medium threat.
visual_unit.traceable_symbolic_representation: The half-open door as active absence.

shot_design.composition_strategy: Long hallway lines converge on the small warm doorway.
shot_design.emotional_rationale: Distance lets the invitation feel real before it becomes personal.

storyboard_shots.blocking: No figure enters; the doorway remains the only active presence.
storyboard_shots.storyboard_frame_prompt: Vertical 9:16 storyboard frame, cinematic live-action realism, narrow apartment hallway at night, cool dark walls, a small half-open door at the far end spilling warm practical light, no people visible, long converging hallway lines, quiet suspense, wide eye-level shot, restrained composition, active absence.

visual_unit.composition_intent: Bring the viewer close enough that the door fills the emotional field.
visual_unit.communication_intent: The threshold now feels like a choice.
visual_unit.expectation_turn_translation: Approach should reveal an answer, but the closer frame makes the absence louder.
visual_unit.active_tension_profile: Medium motion, high absence, high proximity.
visual_unit.traceable_symbolic_representation: Warm light crossing the threshold without revealing its source.

shot_design.composition_strategy: Door edge dominates one side while warm light cuts across the floor.
shot_design.emotional_rationale: The low angle gives the ordinary doorway too much authority.

storyboard_shots.blocking: The door does not move; the threshold holds.
storyboard_shots.storyboard_frame_prompt: Vertical 9:16 storyboard frame, cinematic live-action realism, medium close-up low angle of a half-open apartment door, warm practical light spilling over floorboards into cool darkness, no person visible, the door edge imposing, negative space beyond the crack withheld, quiet suspense, minimal lower-third title area.

visual_unit.composition_intent: Hold on the consequence of not entering.
visual_unit.communication_intent: The unanswered invitation remains after the moment should have resolved.
visual_unit.expectation_turn_translation: Instead of entering or revealing, the video stays with the mark the light leaves behind.
visual_unit.active_tension_profile: Very low motion, high opacity, high absence.
visual_unit.traceable_symbolic_representation: A rectangle of light left on empty floor.

shot_design.composition_strategy: Crop out the door and show only the warm rectangle of light on the floor.
shot_design.emotional_rationale: Removing the door makes the residue more unsettling than the source.

storyboard_shots.blocking: The empty floor holds the aftermath.
storyboard_shots.storyboard_frame_prompt: Vertical 9:16 storyboard frame, cinematic live-action realism, overhead close-up of an empty hallway floor with a warm rectangle of light falling across worn boards, door itself cropped out, no people, no objects, quiet unresolved residue, sparse composition, cool shadows around the light.

audio_cues.description: One quiet floorboard creak under the voiceover question.
The room tone thins into near silence.

audio_plan.notes: Voiceover carries one question; sound design stays sparse enough for absence to lead.

text_track_refs.timing_notes: Starts after the low-angle shot has held for one second.
Minimal lower-third title appears for the final two seconds of the shot.

storyboard_generation_policy.notes: The fixture validates planning only. If storyboard generation is requested, the default generated artifact is one composite multi-panel storyboard sheet; individual stills require separate explicit approval.

traceability_summary.note: The missing figure remains absent in every shot.
The three storyboard shots preserve invitation, threshold, and residue.
The plan stops at storyboard-ready planning and does not imply finished video generation.
